title: Multilingual Customer Support Ticket Classification
description: Classify customer support tickets into 12 categories (Billing, Account, Technical, etc.) across English and Spanish. 80k labeled tickets for training. Test set is held-out, drawn from the same distribution but with some duplicate tickets across train/test.
data_summary: Free-text customer support tickets, multilingual (EN/ES), up to 1500 chars. Duplicates suspected.
